title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Fees, Credit Ceilings and Payment Terms
content:
## Fees and term

The annual program fee is the fee for holding a program of the Demand Service Rate Programs, and the enrollment fee the
one-time fee charged when the program is opened, both in US dollars. The term is the length of one
program term in calendar months.

| Program | Annual program fee (USD) | Enrollment fee (USD) | Term (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 0 | 0 | 12 |
| Priority Response Program | 850 | 250 | 12 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 0 | 0 | 12 |
| Emergency Response Program | 3600 | 450 | 12 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 9800 | 750 | 24 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 24000 | 0 | 24 |

## Credit ceiling and payment

The credit ceiling is the open balance above which no further work is dispatched without office release,
in US dollars. The payment term is the number of calendar days from invoice date to due date. The late
fee figure is the late fee on an overdue invoice per month, in percent per month. The suspension period
is the number of calendar days past due after which dispatch privileges are suspended. The reinstatement
fee is the fee charged when a suspended or lapsed program is restarted, in US dollars, and the restart
window the number of calendar days after the program year end within which a lapsed program can be
restarted at the same rates.

| Program | Credit ceiling (USD) | Payment term (calendar days) | Late fee (percent per month) | Suspension period (calendar days past due) | Reinstatement fee (USD) | Restart window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 7500 | 30 | 1.5 | 45 | 0 | 30 |
| Priority Response Program | 15000 | 30 | 1.5 | 45 | 150 | 45 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 25000 | 30 | 1.5 | 45 | 150 | 45 |
| Emergency Response Program | 40000 | 30 | 1.5 | 30 | 350 | 60 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 75000 | 45 | 1.25 | 30 | 650 | 90 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 150000 | 45 | 1 | 30 | 1200 | 90 |

*Footnote to the fee columns.* A figure of 0 in the annual program fee, enrollment fee or reinstatement
fee column means that program carries no such fee: the Time & Material Account and the Block Hour
Service Program carry no annual program fee and no enrollment fee, and the Dedicated Technician Program
carries no enrollment fee although its annual program fee stands at 24000 US dollars.
